description: Small, focused .NET libraries (netstandard2.0+, Native AOT verified) for commands, specifications, services, schedulers, observable jobs, and a source-generated dispose pattern.
rules: Namespaces omit the .Abstractions suffix: types of Josupeit.Practices.Commands.Abstractions live in Josupeit.Practices.Commands; likewise for Services, Schedulers, and Jobs.

Commands, queries, specifications, and jobs are the executable objects themselves. There is no mediator, no handler interface, and no Send(); construct the object and call Execute, IsSatisfiedBy, or Start.
Override exactly one direction, Execute or ExecuteAsync (IsSatisfiedBy or IsSatisfiedByAsync); the base class bridges the other. Never call the base implementation from the override.

ChannelScheduler must be started before scheduling; a custom SchedulerService enforces that itself, and TaskPoolScheduler has no lifecycle. Jobs deliver progress reports asynchronously, not necessarily in order.
[DisposableMixin] needs a partial class (not a struct or record) without a disposable base class. Implement the Dispose*Resources hooks; never write Dispose() or DisposeAsync() yourself.
Read the package's llms-full.txt for exact signatures before writing code; do not infer overloads that are not listed there.
